title: Borscht Soup with Datterini Tomatoes
description: A twist on the classic Russian borscht soup, this version features the sweet flavor of datterini tomatoes.
instructions: Heat the nimble in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the steamed and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the borscht and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook until the soup is heated through.
Stir in the herbal and russian.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Optional: serve with a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill.
